description: Defines the interface for resource grid mapping in a 5G NR physical layer, including classes for symbol buffering and resource element mapping functions.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping resource elements into a resource grid in the physical layer.

classes.name: symbol_buffer
classes.description: Abstract class for buffering complex symbols to be mapped onto the resource grid.

classes.name: symbol_buffer_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class that wraps a span of symbols to conform to the symbol_buffer interface.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps complex symbols onto the resource grid based on allocation parameters.

methods.name: get_max_block_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of symbols that can be buffered.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the symbol buffer is empty.

methods.name: pop_symbols
methods.description: Retrieves a block of symbols from the buffer.
